findings.evidence: Line 23 vs. the house pattern in `QFT/Scattering/Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean:41` (`public section`) with `energy_def`/`energyFraction_def`/`photonVirtuality_def` `:= (rfl)` (lines 85, 102-104, 141-143); same in `DIS/Polarized/Kinematics.lean:48,117-119`.
findings.fix: Use plain `public section` (plus `noncomputable section`) and add `x_def`, `xi_def`, `beta_def`, `tMinElastic_def` stated as `… := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `x`, `xi`, `beta` and `tMinElastic`, and the file provides no defining lemmas, so every downstream use must unfold the definitions (defeq reliance).

findings.evidence: `DIS/Polarized/Kinematics.lean:65-72` carries `@[ext]` on `PolarizedKinematics`, which has the Prop fields `spin_orthogonal`/`spin_normalized`, and `reverse_reverse` (line 93) discharges by `ext <;> simp`; `Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean:58,72` likewise.
findings.fix: Add `@[ext]` to `structure Invariants`; the four Prop fields are proof-irrelevant and do not obstruct it.
findings.issue: `Invariants` is a bundled definition with no `@[ext]`, so consumers cannot prove two invariant records equal from agreement on `Pq`, `Dq`, `Q2`, `t`; equality and uniqueness reasoning is blocked.

findings.evidence: Line 83 inlines `div_nonneg i.Dq_pos.le i.Pq_pos.le`, i.e. re-derives `0 ≤ i.xi` by unfolding; no occurrence of `xi_pos`/`beta_pos`/`x_pos` in the file (lines 55-85).
findings.fix: Add `xi_pos`, `beta_pos`, `x_pos` (and the `_nonneg` corollaries needed downstream), and use `xi_nonneg` in place of the inlined `div_nonneg i.Dq_pos.le i.Pq_pos.le`.
findings.issue: No positivity API for the derived fractions. The structure carries `Pq_pos`, `Dq_pos`, `Q2_pos` precisely to pin the signs of `x`, `xi`, `beta`, but no `x_pos`/`xi_pos`/`beta_pos` (or `_nonneg`) is exposed; `Q2_pos` is used by nothing at all.

findings.evidence: Lines 102-110 are the whole `tMinElastic` surface; `grep -c '@\[simp\]'` on the new file yields 0, whereas comparable files annotate their characteristic lemmas (`Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean:95,118,124`).
findings.fix: Add `tMinElastic_def` (`:= (rfl)`) and `@[simp] theorem tMinElastic_zero (M : ℝ) : tMinElastic M 0 = 0`.
findings.issue: `tMinElastic` ships only the sign lemma; its characteristic API is missing, including the normal-form value at the forward end `tMinElastic M 0 = 0`, and the file contains no `@[simp]` lemma at all.

summary: The new module exposes every definition body via `@[expose] public section` while supplying no defining lemmas, no `@[ext]` on the bundled `Invariants`, and no positivity API for the derived momentum fractions, so consumers must unfold `x`, `xi`, `beta` and `tMinElastic` to do anything with them.
